title: How do I export uploaded files?
intent: This article explains how to download all files uploaded by respondents.
short_answer: To export uploaded files, navigate to the Exports page and select 'Export Uploaded Elements'. The system creates a ZIP archive containing all files uploaded by respondents through file upload questions. The export runs asynchronously.
prerequisites: Survey must have file upload questions with submitted files
procedure: Wait for the ZIP archive to be generated.
Download the ZIP file when ready.
important_conditions: All uploaded files are packaged into a single ZIP archive.
The export runs asynchronously and may take considerable time for many files.
Files are organized by contribution in the ZIP archive.
Only files from submitted contributions are included.
You will receive an email notification when the download is ready.
troubleshooting: ZIP file very large: This is expected if many files were uploaded.
Missing files: Files from deleted contributions are not included.
